verdict.rationale: There is no first-party doc showing a PM configuring custom fields or status labels in the UI. The only doc hint is developers shipping new 'board column types' via the apps framework, which is a developer building block and earns no credit. Hands-on community reports do say the product itself is heavily customizable and un-opinionated, so teams shape it to their own process, which suggests field and workflow customization exists but leaves its depth unproven. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of custom fields/columns and editable status labels for end users, workflow-status configuration details, and corroborated hands-on examples.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can customize fields and workflow statuses to match my team's process

citations.quote: it required too much setup and customization, much like Jira
